| Top driver — upside | Whole Foods Hydrate Q3 placement on track for Jul; assumed at 80% of confirmed ~$1.65M. |
| Top driver — downside | Wholesale Q3 ASP softness (-2% vs. last forecast) on Restful line — competitive shelf pressure at Target. |
| New SKU | HYD-110 'Sleep Serum' launches Jul 1 — Jun units = 0 by design. Phasing assumes 60-day sell-in ramp (industry std for innovation). |

| Pipeline assumption | Stale Costco opportunity excluded from coverage calc — no activity > 30 days. |
| FX exposure | AMER is USD-only; CAD subsidiary forecasts roll up under EMEA per current org structure. |
| Risks | 1) Glass packaging cost increase 4% effective May (already in COGS); 2) Restful line review at Target end of Q2 — outcome could swing $400-700k. |
| Mitigations | Marketing pulled forward DTC promo for Restful Bath Salt to defend share if Target review goes negative. |
| Open questions | M. Chen — should we include HYD-110 launch contingency or model only base? |

| AMER · Forecast commentary |  |
|---|---|
| Cycle | May 2026 close · Jun-Aug forward look |
| Owner | J. Park |
| Top driver — upside | Whole Foods Hydrate Q3 placement on track for Jul; assumed at 80% of confirmed ~$1.65M. |
| Top driver — downside | Wholesale Q3 ASP softness (-2% vs. last forecast) on Restful line — competitive shelf pressure at Target. |
| New SKU | HYD-110 'Sleep Serum' launches Jul 1 — Jun units = 0 by design. Phasing assumes 60-day sell-in ramp (industry std for innovation). |
| Channel mix shift | DTC growing slightly faster than Amazon; we hold a +200bps GM advantage on DTC vs. Amazon and want to defend. |
| Pipeline assumption | Stale Costco opportunity excluded from coverage calc — no activity > 30 days. |
| FX exposure | AMER is USD-only; CAD subsidiary forecasts roll up under EMEA per current org structure. |
| Risks | 1) Glass packaging cost increase 4% effective May (already in COGS); 2) Restful line review at Target end of Q2 — outcome could swing $400-700k. |
| Mitigations | Marketing pulled forward DTC promo for Restful Bath Salt to defend share if Target review goes negative. |
| Open questions | M. Chen — should we include HYD-110 launch contingency or model only base? |
| Agent triage — appended |  |
| Detected variances | 3: channel-name (1), currency-tag (1), SKU-mapping reclass (1). All within auto-fix policy. |
| Pre-triage tie | FAIL · Detail vs. Summary off by $(188,100) — driven by RST-005 row coded as 'Direct-to-Consumer' (excluded from SUMIFS by 'DTC' criterion). |
| Post-triage tie | PASS · variance < $1,000 tolerance. |
| Pipeline coverage | 1.7× — within band [1.4×, 2.2×]. |
| Confidence | 0.93 (high) on Step 2.1 outputs; full audit trail in Adjustments tab. |
| Suggested next | Channel-name normalization is recurring across cycles — recommend updating regional template dropdown to single 'DTC' value to prevent future drift. |

| How to use this template |  |
| 1. | Receive 3 regional forecast workbooks: AMER, EMEA, APAC. |
| 2. | Map every row to the 'Consolidated_Input' tab. One row per SKU × Channel × Region × Month. |
| 3. | Use the SKU master list to map regional codes to corporate SKUs (e.g., 'NS-UK-RestBath16' → 'RST-001'; 'JP-RST-001' → 'RST-001'). |
| 4. | Use the Channel taxonomy to map regional channel names to the corp 3-channel system: DTC / Amazon / Wholesale. |

| 6. | Net of VAT, returns, and trade promo. Make sure regional submissions are gross/net consistently — ASK if unclear. |
| 7. | Calendar months only — Jun, Jul, Aug 2026. Do NOT use fiscal-year naming. |
| 8. | Validate: Total revenue (Detail tab) must tie to Summary roll-up within $1,000. |

Forecast Consolidation Template — May 2026 close · Jun-Aug 2026 forward look		
How to use this template		
1.	Receive 3 regional forecast workbooks: AMER, EMEA, APAC.	
2.	Map every row to the 'Consolidated_Input' tab. One row per SKU × Channel × Region × Month.	
3.	Use the SKU master list to map regional codes to corporate SKUs (e.g., 'NS-UK-RestBath16' → 'RST-001'; 'JP-RST-001' → 'RST-001').	
4.	Use the Channel taxonomy to map regional channel names to the corp 3-channel system: DTC / Amazon / Wholesale.	
5.	All amounts in LOCAL currency at the row level. The consolidator translates to USD using the current FX forward curve.	
6.	Net of VAT, returns, and trade promo. Make sure regional submissions are gross/net consistently — ASK if unclear.	
7.	Calendar months only — Jun, Jul, Aug 2026. Do NOT use fiscal-year naming.	
8.	Validate: Total revenue (Detail tab) must tie to Summary roll-up within $1,000.

| Forecast Consolidation Template — May 2026 close · Jun-Aug 2026 forward look |  |
| How to use this template |  |
| 1. | Receive 3 regional forecast workbooks: AMER, EMEA, APAC. |
| 2. | Map every row to the 'Consolidated_Input' tab. One row per SKU × Channel × Region × Month. |
| 3. | Use the SKU master list to map regional codes to corporate SKUs (e.g., 'NS-UK-RestBath16' → 'RST-001'; 'JP-RST-001' → 'RST-001'). |
| 4. | Use the Channel taxonomy to map regional channel names to the corp 3-channel system: DTC / Amazon / Wholesale. |
| 5. | All amounts in LOCAL currency at the row level. The consolidator translates to USD using the current FX forward curve. |
| 6. | Net of VAT, returns, and trade promo. Make sure regional submissions are gross/net consistently — ASK if unclear. |
| 7. | Calendar months only — Jun, Jul, Aug 2026. Do NOT use fiscal-year naming. |
| 8. | Validate: Total revenue (Detail tab) must tie to Summary roll-up within $1,000. |
| Tab guide |  |
| Consolidated_Input | FILL ME IN — one row per SKU × channel × region × month |
| SKU master | Reference — corporate SKUs and product taxonomy |
| Channel taxonomy | Reference — only DTC / Amazon / Wholesale are valid |
| Currency rules | Reference — accepted currencies and how to tag local-ccy rows |
| Tie check | Auto — compares Consolidated_Input to expected regional totals |

| AMER · Forecast commentary |  |
|---|---|
| Cycle | May 2026 close · Jun-Aug forward look |
| Owner | J. Park |
| Top driver — upside | Whole Foods Hydrate Q3 placement on track for Jul; assumed at 80% of confirmed ~$1.65M. |
| Top driver — downside | Wholesale Q3 ASP softness (-2% vs. last forecast) on Restful line — competitive shelf pressure at Target. |
| New SKU | HYD-110 'Sleep Serum' launches Jul 1 — Jun units = 0 by design. Phasing assumes 60-day sell-in ramp (industry std for innovation). |
| Channel mix shift | DTC growing slightly faster than Amazon; we hold a +200bps GM advantage on DTC vs. Amazon and want to defend. |
| Pipeline assumption | Stale Costco opportunity excluded from coverage calc — no activity > 30 days. |
| FX exposure | AMER is USD-only; CAD subsidiary forecasts roll up under EMEA per current org structure. |
| Risks | 1) Glass packaging cost increase 4% effective May (already in COGS); 2) Restful line review at Target end of Q2 — outcome could swing $400-700k. |
| Mitigations | Marketing pulled forward DTC promo for Restful Bath Salt to defend share if Target review goes negative. |
| Open questions | M. Chen — should we include HYD-110 launch contingency or model only base? |

| EMEA Q3 forecast notes |  |
|---|---|
| Source of truth | Country sales managers' rolling forecasts, locked 4/29 EOD. Submitted to UK shared drive. |
| Currency | Local (EUR for FR/DE/IT/ES; GBP for UK). NOT translated to USD — corp's job. |
| Magnitude | All values in THOUSANDS of local currency. So 68 = 68,000 GBP, 220 = 220,000 EUR. |
| VAT | Forecast is GROSS of VAT. To net out: amount × (1 − VAT%). Different VAT rates by country (UK 20%, DE 19%, FR 20%, IT 22%, ES 21%). |
| Channel taxonomy | DTC / Marketplace / Retail / Distributor. Note: no 'Wholesale' here; UK 'Retail' = Boots, Sainsbury's. DE 'Distributor' = Müller, DM. |
| Product codes | Internal (NS-{country}-{abbreviation}). Mapping table to master SKU is on UK shared drive — file 'EMEA_SKU_master_v8.xlsx'. Last updated by F. Vasseur 3/14. |
| Risks | Boots Q3 PO not yet in writing. Müller contract renewal mid-Q3 — assumed renewed at flat rate. |
| Open questions | Should we include Mercadona's promo pipeline at full or risk-adjusted? Assumed full. |
| FY calendar | Calendar months — Jun/Jul/Aug 2026 = Q3 calendar. EMEA finance reports on calendar year. |
